purpose: Make the prospect website the primary authority for lane selection and record naming, while conversation notes shape story, ROI, competitive framing, and run coaching.
authorityOrder: known domain and official website product/category signal
conversation notes and SC request context

signals.category: outdoor drinkware coolers bags dealer hardgoods
pet treats and packaged consumer goods

conversationNotesRole: secondary lane evidence only when website signal is weak

rules: Known website/product-family signals are scored separately from conversation notes.
Conversation notes shape story, ROI, competitive framing, exception handling, and run coaching after the lane is selected.
Fallback account and brand terms can support a recommendation but cannot masquerade as website authority.
Weak recommendations must expose low confidence or needs-context language instead of silently accepting a lane.

nllmAdvisoryUse: generate story, ROI, competitive, and run script copy
repair product package and record names when a new website is directionally correct but generic
websitePackageRules: Website product/category evidence owns the lane package, productSeed, productFamily, and demandMoment before conversation notes are applied.
Conversation notes may shape pain, ROI, competitive framing, exceptions, and live run coaching, but must not pull food/beverage object names into dealer hardgoods or apparel lanes.
When a new website is not in known-domain hints, derive package from explicit website/domain/category tokens before using generic lane proof anchors.
If productSeed is equal to the lane proof anchor or contains only Finished Good/Product SKU fallback text, mark N/LLM recommended and expose the fallback reason.
antiLeakRules: Dealer Hardgoods packages must not use ingredient and lot readiness unless the website itself proves food, beverage, ingredient, or lot-controlled goods.
Apparel and Accessories packages must not collapse into industrial distribution when the website shows footwear, apparel, style, size, or color signals.
Food/Beverage terms like finished-good readiness can be used only when the website/category supports packaged food, beverage, ingredient, packaging, or CPG signals.
